# Gerta Xhepi

> Personal portfolio of Gerta Xhepi, a Product Manager building AI, platform and B2B SaaS products.

Gerta Xhepi is a Product Manager with a software engineering background, based in Germany and open to remote product opportunities across Europe. This site collects her selected product work, writing, and professional background.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction and overview of Gerta's work as a Product Manager.
- [About](/about): Background, how she thinks about product, and outside-of-work interests.
- [Work](/work): Selected product case studies across AI, platform and marketplace products.
- [Writing](/writing): Essays on product management, AI, and decision making.
- [Resume](/resume): Professional experience and skills.
- [Product Thinking](/product-thinking): Approach to product discovery and decision making.

## Case studies

- [Salary Transparency](/case-studies/salary-transparency): Building a salary transparency product.
- [Electronic Signature](/case-studies/electronic-signature): Designing an e-signature workflow product.
- [PeakProfile](/case-studies/peakprofile): Product work on PeakProfile.

## Essays

- [AI Problems](/essays/ai-problems): On the real problems facing AI products today.
